sources.observed: BID identifies cafe at 409 Lord Street.
Council licensing record lists Caffe Dolce at 409/411.
Front photograph marks the adjacent 405–407 cafe bay within Burlington, excluding the missing gabled frontage. Floor plan belongs to 405–407 and is not borrowed as a measured plan for 409–411.
Gabled bay between Burlington and Masonic, pale two-storey rectangular bay with large white spandrel, dark cafe shopfront and continuous curved verandah.
Actual loaded 3D front and rear obliques: narrow southwest rear range turns across back; distinct central roof volume, low covered court and open access, not one high ring with a hole.

local_frame: Same site origin/rotation as parent; coordinates below relative to front_origin [60.07300356696527,45.66045790801408], including existing shear.
neighbour_effect: Burlington east edge and bank west edge unchanged. Four-axis facade remapped into 16.45m. Whole 20.85m canopy remains one owner. Cafe and Masonic rear volumes separate at open court; no high east side closes former ring.
uncertainty: Front division ±0.7m, rear boundaries ±1.5m and heights ±1m. Functional/legal ownership of rear arm cannot be established from roof imagery. Rear fenestration, fine gable carving and service fittings remain unresolved. Wider roof review is still open; this establishes separate footprints rather than certifying all roof pitches.
